title: SEC Balance Sheet Health Screen XBRL Frames
description: Optional credential: SEC_EDGAR_CONTACT overrides the default SEC fair-access User-Agent. SEC EDGAR doesn't issue API keys - it just wants a reachable email in the User-Agent string. Leave it unset and the script uses the SpeakesQuery default; set it (e.g. "your.name@example.com") to supply your own contact. Screens all SEC-reporting companies by total assets, total liabilities, and stockholders equity using the XBRL frames API. Calculates debt-to-equity ratio and equity ratio - companies with strong balance sheets (low D/E, high equity ratio) are more resilient in downturns. Flags overleveraged companies (D/E > 3.0) as high-risk and fortress balance sheets (D/E < 0.5) as defensive plays.
code:
import pandas as pd
import requests
import time
from datetime import datetime, timezone

contact = (CREDENTIALS.get('SEC_EDGAR_CONTACT') or '').strip()
if not contact or '@' not in contact:
    # SEC EDGAR's fair-access policy accepts any User-Agent that contains
    # a reachable email - it is NOT an API key / authentication token. Fall
    # back to the project default so scheduled SEC jobs run out of the box;
    # users can override by setting SEC_EDGAR_CONTACT in Settings → Credentials.
    contact = 'SpeakesQuery EDGAR (noreply@speakesquery.local)'
HEADERS = {'User-Agent': contact}
now_epoch = int(datetime.now(timezone.utc).timestamp())

now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
year = now.year
month = now.month
if month <= 3:
    q_year = year - 1
    quarter = 4
elif month <= 6:
    q_year = year
    quarter = 1
elif month <= 9:
    q_year = year
    quarter = 2
else:
    q_year = year
    quarter = 3

period = f'CY{q_year}Q{quarter}I'

# Fetch assets, liabilities, and equity
concepts = ['Assets', 'Liabilities', 'StockholdersEquity']
all_data = {}

for concept in concepts:
    url = f'https://data.sec.gov/api/xbrl/frames/us-gaap/{concept}/USD/{period}.json'
    resp = requests.get(url, headers=HEADERS, timeout=30)
    if resp.status_code != 200:
        continue
    entries = resp.json().get('data', [])
    for entry in entries:
        cik = int(entry.get('cik', 0))
        if cik not in all_data:
            all_data[cik] = {
                'entity_name': entry.get('entityName', ''),
                'filed_date': entry.get('filed', ''),
                'form': entry.get('form', ''),
            }
        all_data[cik][concept] = float(entry.get('val', 0))
    time.sleep(0.15)

rows = []
cik_list = list(all_data.keys())
for cik in cik_list:
    info = all_data[cik]
    assets = info.get('Assets', 0)
    liabilities = info.get('Liabilities', 0)
    equity = info.get('StockholdersEquity', 0)

    if assets <= 0:
        continue

    debt_to_equity = round(liabilities / equity, 4) if equity > 0 else 999.0
    equity_ratio = round(equity / assets, 4) if assets > 0 else 0.0

    if debt_to_equity > 3.0:
        health = 'HIGH_LEVERAGE'
    elif debt_to_equity > 1.5:
        health = 'MODERATE_LEVERAGE'
    elif debt_to_equity > 0.5:
        health = 'HEALTHY'
    elif debt_to_equity >= 0:
        health = 'FORTRESS'
    else:
        health = 'NEGATIVE_EQUITY'

    rows.append({
        'cik': cik,
        'entity_name': info.get('entity_name', ''),
        'period': period,
        'total_assets': assets,
        'total_liabilities': liabilities,
        'stockholders_equity': equity,
        'assets_billions': round(assets / 1_000_000_000, 2),
        'debt_to_equity': debt_to_equity,
        'equity_ratio': equity_ratio,
        'balance_sheet_health': health,
        'filed_date': info.get('filed_date', ''),
        'form': info.get('form', ''),
        '_epoch': now_epoch,
    })

df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
if not df.empty:
    df = df.sort_values('total_assets', ascending=False).reset_index(drop=True)
GENERATE_RESULTS(df)
